sources.entry: Listmonk - High performance, self-hosted newsletter and mailing list manager with a modern dashboard. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Go/Docker
listmonk | High-performance newsletter and mailing list manager

summary.one_liner: listmonk is a self-hosted newsletter and mailing list manager packaged as a single binary that uses PostgreSQL as its data store.
summary.what_it_does: listmonk is a standalone, self-hosted newsletter and mailing list manager. It is distributed as a single binary and stores its data in a PostgreSQL database. The README describes it as fast and feature-rich, with a modern dashboard noted in the awesome-selfhosted listing. It can be installed via Docker using a sample docker-compose.yml, or as a binary that generates a config.toml and sets up or upgrades the Postgres schema through command-line flags. The backend is written in Go and the frontend in Vue with Buefy. The README does not list specific sending features beyond this.
use_cases: run an email newsletter on my own server
how_to_run: ./listmonk --install  (set up the Postgres DB; use --upgrade for existing DBs)
./listmonk  (then visit the web address shown in the README)
notable: Ships as a single binary with a PostgreSQL backend
Docker image and sample docker-compose.yml available
Install and upgrade are run via --install and --upgrade commands, with idempotent upgrades
Live demo available per the README
caveats: Licensed under AGPL v3, which carries copyleft obligations for modified versions
